data.name: Haswell
data.long_meaning: Originally derived from Old English ‘hæs’ meaning ‘hay’ and ‘wealh’ meaning ‘foreigner’ or ‘stranger’. The name Haswell was likely given to someone who lived near a haystack or a well that was surrounded by hay. In a spiritual context, the name could represent a place of refuge or shelter, as well as a connection to the earth and nature.
